intro: Zargh is an orc meat merchant stationed at the Crossroads in the Barrens. Aside from providing provisions to travelers, he frequently supplies choice cuts of local game to Innkeeper Gryshka in Orgrimmar.

p: Amid the bustle of the Crossroads, Zargh tends his shop selling various cuts of cured meat, shank, and game taken from the surrounding plains. For adventurers pushing deep into the harsh wilderness, his stocks provide vital nourishment. Beyond basic trade, he maintains close ties with the Horde capital, regularly shipping carefully selected meats across Durotar to Gryshka, the innkeeper of the Valley of Strength.
